feeds.title: Natasha Crain Blog
feeds.description: My passion is to equip Christian parents to raise kids with an understanding of how to make a case for and defend their faith in an increasingly secular world.

feeds.title: Christian Parenting
feeds.description: At Christian Parenting.org, we are believers just like you, and we are committed to raising our children to know God and live as lights to those around us. We believe that the Lord has a message for each of us parenting in today's culture.

feeds.title: Forward in Christ Magazine
feeds.description: Heart to heart parenting blog is meant to be an honest forum for Christian parents to build each other up and support each other.

feeds.title: Orthodox Christian Parenting
feeds.description: Subscribe for Encouragement and ideas for Orthodox Christians raising children in The Faith. From the Antiochian Orthodox Department of Christian Education.

feeds.title: Crosswalk.com » Parenting
feeds.description: Crosswalk.com is brought to you by a group of writers, editors and content producers seeking to provide applicable, educational and entertaining content to followers of Jesus Christ regardless of where they are in their respective spiritual journeys. We strive to provide timely information on everything from Marriage, Parenting and Family issues, to Bible Study, Prayer, Spiritual Growth and more.

feeds.title: Cornerstones for Parents
feeds.description: Cornerstones for Parents is an online resource for Christian parents founded by Laura Kuehn, LCSW. Laura is a licenced clincial social worker with a specialization in children and families. She writes practical, biblically-grounded articles designed to help Christian parents disciple, instruct and grow with their kids.

feeds.title: Arabah Joy Blog
feeds.description: Here at ArabahJoy.com, I help women grow in intimacy with God so they live lives of purpose, joy, and passion, and leave a legacy of faith and strength for others to follow.

feeds.title: The Character Corner Blog » Parenting
feeds.description: Raising Godly children with strong Christian Character. My goal is to help and encourage parents to be purposeful in raising their kids to love God, and have Godly character. You'll find encouragement for parenting, homeschooling, and winning your child's heart, We also offer Biblical based resources to help you.

feeds.title: Mom Remade
feeds.description: Mom Remade by Julie Plagens is a mildly humorous but helpful blog that gives tips on parenting, marriage, faith, and Christian family living. As a teacher and a mom of two grown children, Julie understands the real struggle women face every day as they try to juggle the endless balancing acts of work and family life and showcases some honest encouragement about life with a biblical twist.

feeds.title: Growing 4 Life » Parenting
feeds.description: Welcome to Growing4Life! I am Leslie and this blog is dedicated to living according to God's Word, no matter what the rest of the world says!

feeds.title: The Little Shoots, Deep Roots Blog
feeds.description: Follow this blog to get Simple, inspiring ideas to help you and your child grow in faith.

feeds.title: The Awkward Mom Blog » Parenting
feeds.description: Hi, I am Janel Breitenstein. My goal is to pack this baby full of ideas on practical spirituality and loving each other.

feeds.title: Equipping Godly Women Blog » Parenting
feeds.description: Hi, I am Brittany. Welcome to Equipping Godly Women. Helping you be the amazing woman God created you to be. Here you will find topics including Christian faith, marriage, parenting, homemaking and community.

feeds.title: Reformed Perspective » Parenting
feeds.description: Articles, news, and reviews on Parenting to inform, equip, and encourage Christians. Reformed Perspective's mission is 'To promote a Biblically Reformed perspective in all spheres of life by equipping and encouraging Christians to think, speak, and act in a manner consistent with their confession.'

feeds.title: Christian Mommy Blog
feeds.description: Christian Mommy provides moms with practical, thought-provoking articles to equip and encourage them in their parenting journey and nourish their spiritual life.

feeds.title: Raising Christian Kids Blog
feeds.description: Christian parenting 101! Read through a faith-guided library of insightful articles, our favorite resources, recommendations + more. Raising Christian Kids exists to equip and empower ministry leaders, parents, grandparents, teachers, and all who are raising the next generation to help little ones to have a strong foundation in Jesus!

feeds.title: Just Homemaking Blog » Parenting
feeds.description: Find Christian Mom & Parenting encouragement by joining us in our Just Homemaking community. Read real-life struggles and faith-focused solutions. The heart and intent of this blog are to encourage women who take care of their homes, their husbands, and their kids to run the race set out before them. Whether you're a full-time homemaker, or you take care of your home and your people after work hours, God has entrusted you with an amazing ministry.

feeds.title: D6 Family » Parenting
feeds.description: D6 is a movement intentional about empowering parents, homes, marriages, leaders, and churches to live out the story of Deuteronomy 6. D6 provides resources to align the church and home to accomplish God's design of generational discipleship. Read articles exploring the topic of parenting, different tips, ideas, and more in the following section of D6 Family.

feeds.title: Expository Parenting Ministries Blog
feeds.description: Expository Parenting Ministries exist to inform, equip, and connect Christian parents for the verse-by-verse discipleship of their children. Rather than conjuring up our own parenting strategy, or relying on fallible human wisdom, this ministry is committed to the reality that God's Word is capable of accomplishing in the lives of children everything that Christian parents could ever want to accomplish.

feeds.title: Inspire the Mom Blog
feeds.description: Welcome! I'm Jessica. I'm a Christ-follower, wife to the joyful Mr. Coppertop, and a busy mom of three littles. I spend nap time aspiring to inspire. On this blog you will find Ideas and encouragement for the stay at home schooling mom.

feeds.title: Thriving Kids Connection
feeds.description: National Center for Biblical Parenting is committed to helping parents develop biblical, practical strategies for touching the hearts of their kids.

feeds.title: Parenting Like Hannah
feeds.description: Encouraging parents in their efforts to raise their children to be enthusiastic servants of the Lord.

feeds.title: ReFocus Blog » Parenting
feeds.description: Welcome to ReFocus, a ministry for transition. The goal of this blog is not to provide all the answers or give a cookie-cutter approach to transitioning to family ministry, but rather to provide encouragement, support, resources and prayer as you move forward in your church.

feeds.title: Faithful Parenting
feeds.description: The mission and purpose of Faithful Parenting is to equip moms faithful to their children and full of faith in God's promises for their families. We serve dedicated moms who treasure motherhood with the skills, wisdom, and knowledge to raise fantastic kids and build a tethered family. We provide moms with written guidance, parenting courses, and personalized parenting coaching.

feeds.title: Counselor Thoughts with Michelle Nietert » Parenting
feeds.description: HI, I am Michelle Nietert. I am the mom of a six year old boy and nine year old girl and believe that parenting is one of my highest current callings.

feeds.title: Julia Roller Blog » Parenting
feeds.description: Seeking Grace in the Chaos. Prayer, Parenting and much more by Julia Roller.

feeds.title: The Doorposts Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Doorposts! We are delighted and privileged to join you as you serve God by raising up godly children who love and obey His Word. Our goal is to provide you with Bible-based tools that make your job easier. Our mission is to supply Christian parents with Bible-based, parent-designed, family-tested products to help you apply Scripture in the home.

feeds.title: Gentle Christian Parenting Blog
feeds.description: A place for moms and all caregivers of children to find connection, biblical wisdom, and encouragement for raising up children in a God-honoring, Christ-centered way. Author Christina, passionate about helping Christian parents, writes about Building Character, Parenting Challenges, Parenting Tips, and Positive Discipline.

feeds.title: Intoxicated on Life Blog » Intentional Parenting
feeds.description: Join Luke and Trisha to raise holistically healthy children: nurturing their bodies, cultivating their minds, and inspiring their souls. Intentional parenting tells us how we can use Auto-pilot mode as an easy way to save our sanity-just go with the flow of parenting. The couple teaches us how to tackle the tough parenting challenges in our culture in a God-honoring way.

feeds.title: With Quiet Hands Blog
feeds.description: Hey! I'm a wife and mama of two beautiful kiddos. I believe in the power of words, beauty, faith, grace, and love. While I love to theorize about and strive for parenting ideals, I value the art of keeping them real. Thanks for reading.
